description:
Start an outbound AI phone call.

        With ``from_`` omitted, Hail uses the oldest active workspace number with
        voice capability, or a shared pool number when none is available.
        A dedicated number is not required. Shared pool numbers cannot be selected
        explicitly; an exhausted pool returns an ``error`` result without starting a call.
        The call uses instructions from ``system_prompt`` or a saved ``agent_id``,
        or a model endpoint supplied in ``llm``. At least one is required.
        US artificial-voice calls (47 CFR 64.1200(b)(1)) require the AI disclosure.
        Hail does not verify the lawful basis or the recipient's consent.
        A 4xx response returns no ``idempotency_key``.

        Returns the call ID, status, phone numbers and ``idempotency_key``, or an error.

agent_id.description: Saved agent whose settings the call uses, from ``list_agents`` or ``create_agent``. Explicit arguments override its settings.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

ai_disclosure.description: Whether the agent speaks an AI notice at the start of the call.
ai_disclosure.title: Ai Disclosure

consent_obtained_at.description: When consent was obtained, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, if known.
consent_obtained_at.title: Consent Obtained At

consent_source.description: Where or how consent was obtained, such as ``signup form``. Required when ``message_type`` is ``marketing``.
consent_source.title: Consent Source

first_message.description: Line spoken on pickup. Without it, the agent reacts to the answer or silence.
first_message.title: First Message

from_.description: Caller ID: an E.164 workspace number with voice, from ``list_numbers``. This selects a dedicated voice number instead of automatic caller-ID selection.
from_.title: From

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. The ``idempotency_key`` from an earlier response refers to that original request instead of starting a new one. Omitted: a new key is generated and returned.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

language.description: Spoken language override, using a supported lowercase ISO 639-1 code such as ``es``. When omitted, the call uses the saved agent's language, then the workspace's text-to-speech language if configured, then English. An unsupported code returns an error before dialing.
language.title: Language

llm.description: Own model endpoint compatible with OpenAI's chat completions API: ``{base_url, api_key, model}``. Omitted: Hail's bundled model.
llm.title: Llm

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

message_type.description: Purpose of the communication for consent checks. Transactional or service messages are ``informational``; promotional messages are ``marketing``.
message_type.title: Message Type

metadata.description: Extra data stored on the call record. Keys starting with ``recording_`` are reserved.
metadata.title: Metadata

recipient_consent.description: Confirmation from the user that the recipient lawfully agreed to be contacted. Hail requires ``true`` and does not independently verify consent.
recipient_consent.title: Recipient Consent

recording_enabled.description: Recording for this call, overriding the agent and workspace settings.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled

system_prompt.description: Task instructions, added to the call agent's instructions.
system_prompt.title: System Prompt

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, such as ``+14155551234``.
to.title: To

tools.description: Names of the agent tools allowed on this call. An empty list: only the tools every call keeps (end_call, send_dtmf and Hail's settings guide). A saved agent's HTTP tools stay on. Omitted: every tool the workspace's channels support.
tools.title: Tools

name: place_call

at.description: When the speaker started this turn, ISO 8601. When that is not known, when Hail recorded the turn.
at.title: At

role.description: 'assistant' is the Hail agent. 'user' is the person (or answering machine) on the other end of the line.
role.title: Role

text.description: What was said in this turn.
text.title: Text

agent_id.description: Agent that answered (inbound) or placed (outbound) this call. Null when the call was placed with an inline system_prompt.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

answered_at.description: When the callee answered, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null if never answered.
answered_at.title: Answered At

caller_hidden_reason.description: Why Hail recorded an inbound caller as 'anonymous'. 'phone_system_sent_own_number': the connected phone system sent one of your own numbers as the caller, not the real caller's number. Set your phone system to pass the caller's number. Null when Hail kept the caller as sent, including a caller who withheld their number.
caller_hidden_reason.title: Caller Hidden Reason

direction.description: 'outbound' for calls Hail placed, 'inbound' for calls received.
direction.title: Direction

end_reason.description: Machine-readable reason the call reached a terminal status (e.g. 'normal_hangup', 'user_rejected', 'sip_trunk_failure'). Null while the call is still in progress.
end_reason.title: End Reason

ended_at.description: When the call ended, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null while still in progress.
ended_at.title: Ended At

failure_message.description: Human-readable explanation for a failed call. Null for other statuses.
failure_message.title: Failure Message

from_e164.description: Caller-id phone number used, E.164 format.
from_e164.title: From E164

idempotency_key.description: Key that identifies this exact request when retrying.

initial_prompt.description: The system_prompt this call was created with, if any.
initial_prompt.title: Initial Prompt

livekit_room.description: Name of the LiveKit room hosting this call's media session, if one was created.
livekit_room.title: Livekit Room

organization_id.description: Organization that placed or received this call.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

provider_call_sid.description: The telephony provider's identifier for this call leg, if assigned.
provider_call_sid.title: Provider Call Sid

recording_duration_ms.description: Duration of captured audio, independent of billed call duration.
recording_duration_ms.title: Recording Duration Ms

recording_enabled.description: Whether the recording-enabled call rate applies, regardless of capture outcome.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled

recording_s3_key.description: Internal storage key for the call recording. Not a directly fetchable URL.
recording_s3_key.title: Recording S3 Key

recording_status.description: disabled, requested, starting, recording, processing, ready, unavailable, failed, or erased.
recording_status.title: Recording Status

requested_at.description: When the call was requested, ISO 8601 timestamp.
requested_at.title: Requested At

started_at.description: When dialing began, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until the call starts.
started_at.title: Started At

status.description: Current call-progress state: 'queued', 'dialing', 'ringing', 'in_progress', or one of the terminal states 'completed', 'failed', 'busy', 'no_answer', 'canceled'.
status.title: Status

transcript.description: What was said on the call, in the order it was said. Set only by GET /v1/calls/{call_id}: an empty list until someone speaks. Null in POST /v1/calls and GET /v1/calls responses.
transcript.title: Transcript

title: Place a phone call
